title: Sampling rate calculation is incorrect/incomplete in MP3 sniffer
body:
### What is the issue with the MIME Sniffing Standard?

The text reads:
`Let samplerate be the value given by samplerate-index in the sample-rate table.`
with the table being:
```
index	samplerate
0	44100
1	48000
2	32000
```

however: as per 
[ISO/IEC 13818-3](https://www.iso.org/iso/iso_catalogue/catalogue_ics/catalogue_detail_ics.htm?csnumber=26797)
"Extension of ISO/IEC 11172-3 Audio Coding to Lower Sampling Frequencies"

```
In order to achieve better audio quality at very low bit rates (<64 kbit/s per audio channel), in particular if compared
with CCITT Standard G-722 performance, three additional sampling frequencies are provided for ISO/IEC 11172-3
layers I, II and III. The additional sampling frequencies are 16 kHz, 22,05 kHz and 24 kHz.
...
These new definitions are valid if the ID bit in the
ISO/IEC 11172-3 header equals zero. To obtain the best audio performance, the parameters of the psychoacoustic
model used in the encoder have to be changed accordingly.
```


so one should add:
`if version is 2, let samplerate be the result of samplerate / 2`

Additionally, for MPEG2.5 (Fraunhofer proprietary) additional sampling frequencies are defined: 8kHz, 11,025kHz and 12kHz
`if version is 0, let sample rate be the result of samplerate / 4`

Note the Mozilla's firefox already does so for their mp3 sniffing:
https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/source/toolkit/components/mediasniffer/mp3sniff.c#43-47

And FFmpeg:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/master/libavcodec/mpegaudiodecheader.c#L44-L57

Additionally for somewhat easier to read:
http://www.mp3-tech.org/programmer/frame_header.html#:~:text=Table_title:%20Description%20Table_content:%20header:%20%7C%20bits%20%7C,%7C%20MPEG1:%20reserv.%20%7C%20MPEG2.5:%20reserv.%20%7C

See Sampling rate frequency index
